description: Suit:  2-piece: A: shirt style jacket and B: skirt; B: purple, pleated skirt. a: Short Sleeve shirt style jacket. 5 slat buttons round and plastic, button on back, top went over waist band. Jacket mother of pearl with one replacement. b: 2 side patch pockets in skirt with hooks and eye to close them. Wide base band with darts to fit..... Color=eggplant aubergine.  Ready made size 18 found in seam; American, probably California.  a:  Eggplant Purple Jacket, two patch pockets with button on each. Four front pearly buttons and one collar button. Short sleeve. Gathered at shoulder seams. Cuffed sleeves. sloe slits (2 3/4 inch) gathering on back.  b: Pleated full length eggplant purple skirt. Two slit pockets. Two hook and eye closures and buttons down the back center. Hanging straps on interior.  Similar to Vera skirt pleated - pleats sewn c. 7 inches.
